comments: Reviewed source composition, source-foot pivots and cell order. Supplemental poses are reviewed proposals, not added animation states.
Exact canvas, stamp and rule timings retained. Native cleanup and plate slicing bake once in the renderer.
Visual registration: horizontal crop centre, bottom at shared feet. Reject lowest-band mean: a stretched boot forced every pose too small.
Rule foot is canvas height minus 2: preserve the renderer +2 stamp offset; leave two transparent rows below the feet.
geometry: Enemy-shot hurtbox 16×37 (16×19 duck), centred on feet x; Area::hits uses same dimensions. supports()/landing() from Rafterwake own ±4 px lip. Muzzle x=sample x+dir×18, y=sample feet−10 duck/−29 up/−12 down/−18 level.
mapping_basis: Visual review of source sheets and cleanup notes, 2026-10-15

size_basis: 48×48, occupied height 45 in report; top-left screen feet−(24,46), foot local (24,46). Recipe e/f/g/h cloth is converted to I/r/o/t then seat-mapped; preserve mask/material distinction.
timing: Twelve bodies; run 2×5 ticks. Land pose_ticks=4 then same-step decrement; respawn land=6. Jump/fall driven by velocity; shoot/aim held by input (not cooldown). Shot cooldown=12; down=18, protection=30, freeze=2, COYOTE=4, BUFFER=5. GRAVITY=112,JUMP=1536,RUN=640 fixed units (Lane::step_at).
